basic_info.headline: Machine Learning Engineer – Hugging Face
basic_info.about: ML Engineer with a passion for making the latest NLP research more efficient and applicable in real-life scenarios. Currently interested in few/zero-shot learning, transformer-based models (NLP & CV), ML infrastructure.

work_experience.notes: Currently: the SmolLM series. Built large-scale text and code datasets (The Stack V2, FineWeb-Edu, Cosmopedia). Co-created the Diffusers library: diffusion models for image and audio generation (DDPM, LDM, Stable Diffusion). Maintained audio transformers (SEW-D, Wav2Vec, HuBERT, WavLM), and datasets (Common Voice, XTREME-S).

work_experience.location: Produced efficient transformer/BERT-based models for multitask learning on legal documents and multilingual scientific papers. Developed an accurate syntax tagging, lemmatization and NER pipeline for Russian and English documents. Focused on information retrieval and few-shot learning research, making efficient production-ready models, ML infrastructure.

work_experience.notes: Worked on a cross-lingual document search engine, and a customer message classification system for tech support. Focused on clients' data ETL, dataset construction for information retrieval, machine learning infrastructure, and active learning techniques for low-resource text classification and NER. Data Engineer Feb 2018 - Jun 2019 · 1 yr 5 mos

Full-stack development of a custom orchestration platform for automated software testing, spanning thousands of virtual machines. Also developed a crash logs classification service for automatic bug report search using NLP techniques. Infrastructure Development Intern Mar 2016 - Jun 2017 · 1 yr 4 mos
